parsed.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large, well-lit warehouse aisle with high metal racks on both sides. The floor is polished concrete, and yellow safety barriers line the rack bases. Forklifts and pallets are visible, along with workers in red shirts. Overhead signs indicate aisle numbers like '3' and '13'.

objects.label: warehouse rack
objects.observation: Tall black metal rack on the right side, labeled '13', filled with stacked boxes and crates. Yellow protective barriers at base. Partially occludes view of adjacent rack.

objects.label: forklift
objects.observation: Orange and gray forklift parked near left wall, forks down. Positioned under overhead sign '3'. No visible operator. Floor contact evident.

objects.label: worker
objects.observation: Person wearing red shirt walking in distance down aisle, holding mop or broom. Partially occluded by racks. Appears to be cleaning floor.

objects.label: pallet with boxes
objects.observation: Stacked pallets with shrink-wrapped boxes located near center aisle, beside another forklift. Boxes appear uniform and organized.

objects.label: yellow safety barrier
objects.observation: Yellow plastic or metal barrier running along base of right-side rack. Attached to rack legs. Provides visual separation from walkway.
